- [USER] User asked for more information about steps being taken to ensure the health of River Clyde's ecosystems.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Restoration programs improve river banks, vegetation, and habitats for aquatic life.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Greater waste management policies and annual dredging activities are in place to remove pollutants.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Education programs teach the public about the importance of ecosystem health.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Partnerships among government, private, and non-profit organizations aim for sustainability.
